item.title: [DIS] Hardening Kirea Finance (Native RWA Lending on CKB) (1 posts)
item.description: Summary Kirea Finance is a native Real-World Asset (RWA) pattern built on CKB, which represents real-world asset claims as unique, ownable on-chain assets that owners can hold, transfer, or use as collateral for loans. The full lifecycle, from asset issuance and KYC attestation through deposit, borrowing, repayment, and release, is already implemented on the CKB testnet, with no external bridges or custodians required. This proposal requests $7,250 to harden the existing testnet pattern for broader ecosystem use. The grant will fund generalizing the attestation and asset components, replacing mocked KYC with a live Sumsub API integration, and handling repayment edge cases. By focusing on...

item.title: CKB Off Chain Aba: Event Overview (3 posts)
item.description: On October 3, 2026, we brought CKB Off Chain to Aba, Abia State. We worked closely with Abia Web3 Network to make this happen. The weather was terrible, it rained heavily for most of the day, but the people who showed up were exactly the right ones. IMG_20261005_124116_7911280×853 108 KB Setting the Foundation I kicked things off by breaking down what CKB actually is and why anyone should care. We didn’t just jump into code. We talked about why blockchain was created in the first place and how CKB stays true to those roots. We covered the Cell Model, explaining it like sealed envelopes, so even people without a blockchain background could understand. I also introduced RGB++ and Fiber...

item.description: Love the idea of making wallet connection a P2P layer you set up once and forget. The CCC App module is a smart bridge too, since it makes every CCC-supported wallet a Khie wallet from day one. Reviving the Cryptape Trust hardware wallet through it is a nice touch.
